source: blab's vsaGeneralize (public runner), parameter sequence reproduced exactly

setparam.pertAmp: 1-D field (all zeros) x strength, set before every trial
setparam.pertAmp2D: full-strength calc_pertField field, sent once by AudapterIO('init') (bShift2D = 1)

switching: setParam pertAmp = strength x p.pertAmp before every trial (run_vsaGeneralize_audapter.m:117-118); AudapterIO('init') once
input: synthetic male vowels (F0 120 Hz) at Hillenbrand men's means for /i/, /ae/, /a/, /u/ (the lab's default corner vowels) and /I/, /E/
playground_left_out: the trial sequence: the link loads one trial's settings; run several trials as one session in the Playground to see carry-over
